ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Defense Acquisition Program Act) <No. 598, April 24, 2006>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.
Articles 2 through 6 Omitted.
Article 7 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) through (7) Omitted.
(8) Part of the Rules on the Scope of Criminal Suspects Whose Fingerprints Shall Be Taken shall be amended as follows:
In the attached Table, "Act on Special Measures for the Defense Industry" shall be replaced with "Defense Acquisition Program Act."
(9) and (10) Omitted.
Article 8 Omitted.
